answer_1.quote: We design a Constrained Sentence Generation (CG) probing task... where the model must generate a knowledge-grounded sentence based on a given triple <s, r, o>.
answer_1.outputs: Sentences generated from input triples, e.g., 'lions don't live in the ocean'

answer_2.quote: Due to the controlled task setting... the CG task can be efficiently evaluated by detecting the existence of negation cues... we use keywords-based matching for negation cues, followed by a RoBERTa model as a token classifier... This metric produces 1 or 0 based on the finding of negation cues in a sentence.

answer_4.quote: We manually evaluate the factuality of generated texts based on commonsense knowledge... After examining 100 cases...
answer_4.guideline: Sentences that make common sense and adhere to the keywords constraints are accepted as true.
